title: didn't survive cat naps
text:
didn't survive cat naps. Decent. Held a lot of size 6, also accommodated size 12, just obviously not as much. Good in a pinch. Wasn't a long term solution for me... my cats liked to sleep on the top of it and it ended up tearing a few months later, then came crashing down and once a few of the paper coated plastic shoe shelves rip it just doesn't stand right.

I also had to keep it zipped up to keep my shoes out of sight of my young dogs, which worked great, but I barely used the zipper and one side split.
